title: Verify OpenSPG/KAG schema import and citation-preserving retrieval
milestone: M2: Verified KAG and scientific integrations
body:
Deploy a version-pinned development stack. Import the draft schema, ingest canonical IDs and provenance, implement the KAG adapter, and verify a real query plus unavailable-server behavior. Attach redacted logs and exact versions. No silent fallback.

Acceptance: implementation and relevant behavior tests pass; docs state verification evidence and remaining limitations.

title: Verify DYNAMO catalog contract and implement reviewed model crosswalk
milestone: M2: Verified KAG and scientific integrations
body:
Confirm catalog deployment URL/auth and current OpenAPI; exercise models and standardvariables reads, pagination and errors. Map Software/Version/Configuration/Setup and variable identities without asserting model applicability. Include provenance and contract fixtures.

Acceptance: implementation and relevant behavior tests pass; docs state verification evidence and remaining limitations.

title: Align scientific variables with a verified SVO vocabulary
milestone: M2: Verified KAG and scientific integrations
body:
Choose an authoritative vocabulary release and stable identifiers. Review units/context mappings for SDM variables. Distinguish vocabulary resolution from workflow transform-specs. Preserve ambiguous/unmapped states and human review.

Acceptance: implementation and relevant behavior tests pass; docs state verification evidence and remaining limitations.

title: Implement persistent learned-embedding hybrid retrieval
milestone: M2: Verified KAG and scientific integrations
body:
Add pgvector migrations/indexing and versioned embeddings, source hashes and transactional evidence validation. Compare lexical/vector/hybrid on identical corpora; optional infrastructure is currently unused. Add migration/rollback and retrieval integration tests.

Acceptance: implementation and relevant behavior tests pass; docs state verification evidence and remaining limitations.

title: Build licensed SDM corpus and independently adjudicated benchmark
body:
Collect licensed publications and reviewed exact-span evidence. Separate development and held-out documents/questions. Include no-answer and wrong-context cases, sampling bias, transfer validity and habitat-vs-transmission limitations. Record annotator agreement and adjudication.

Acceptance: implementation and relevant behavior tests pass; docs state verification evidence and remaining limitations.

title: Add reviewed scientific claim extraction and promotion workflow
body:
Extract candidates with source span, DOI/identifier, region, time, assumptions and uncertainty. Keep candidates isolated from authoritative catalog knowledge and retrieval until explicit review. Evaluate extraction separately from retrieval and generation.

Acceptance: implementation and relevant behavior tests pass; docs state verification evidence and remaining limitations.

title: Extend student workbench with persistent experiments and human rubrics
body:
Add isolated projects, saved configurations/results and human relevance/applicability/faithfulness rubrics. Design auth and data retention before multiuser use. Preserve reproducibility metadata and exports.

Acceptance: implementation and relevant behavior tests pass; docs state verification evidence and remaining limitations.

title: Design evidence-grounded generation and approved SDM execution boundary
body:
Add an independently evaluated citation-grounded answer layer with abstention before any execution. Design a separate approved MINT execution workflow; do not equate habitat suitability with disease risk. Require data/readiness and model applicability review.

Acceptance: implementation and relevant behavior tests pass; docs state verification evidence and remaining limitations.

title: Register scientific-dss-kag in DSO architecture documentation
body:
Review docs/dso-registration.md, choose cluster and confirm proposed local port. Update DSO service page, repo map, port reference and MkDocs nav; regenerate graph. No production deployment or URL is currently assigned.

Acceptance: implementation and relevant behavior tests pass; docs state verification evidence and remaining limitations.
